title: cheminformatics: code, analyses and manuscript for “Comparator construction can reverse the apparent advantage of peak-token MS/MS models over binned baselines”
description:
Archived release of the repository supporting Pan X, Wang C, Comparator construction can reverse the apparent advantage of peak-token MS/MS models over binned baselines.

Contains the five-arm ablation ladder and its training code, the two architecture-specific hyperparameter searches and their selection tables, the target-resampling and scaffold-cluster bootstraps, the split-integrity audit, the peak-absorption and bin-width analyses, every per-seed metric and per-target average precision behind the reported numbers, and the scripts that regenerate every figure and table.

It also contains msms-controls, a NumPy-only package exposing the study's two controls so they can be applied to other models: a rounding control that quantises the mass axis inside a peak-token pipeline, so the representation can be varied while the encoder is held fixed, and a conditioning-parity check that asserts every arm of an ablation actually responds to the acquisition metadata it was given — a silent failure that accounted for +0.0288 macro AUPRC in this study.
